description: This file defines the Tag class for managing blog post tags, including retrieval, listing, validation, saving, assigning, and removal of tags within the Goteo project.

classes.name: Tag
classes.description: Model class for handling blog post tags, including CRUD operations and tag associations.

methods.name: getLangFields
methods.description: Returns the list of fields that are language-specific, in this case, 'name'.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a tag by its ID, considering language support.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns a list of all tags, optionally filtered by a specific post.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Returns a simple list of tags with usage count.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the tag object, ensuring the name is not empty.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves or updates the tag in the database.

methods.name: assign
methods.description: Associates a tag with a post.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a tag association from a post.
